description: Reliability workflow for Codex CLI. Plan, build, resume, recover, and verify from plain-English requests. Trust hooks via /hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Reliability workflow for Codex CLI: plan → build → verify.
interface.longDescription: Anyone Can Code CLI is the terminal reliability workflow package for OpenAI Codex. Free open-source plugin: plan, build, resume, recover, and verify from plain English. Install from /plugins, trust hooks with /hooks, run $setup. Open beta.
defaultPrompt: I want to build something, but I may be starting from an idea, a repo, or a bug.
Resume my last workflow and tell me the next best step.
Verify what changed and tell me what is still uncertain.
